transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm a construction manager, and... I guess what brings me in is I'm having a really hard time staying focused at work. 

I'll start a safety briefing or sit down for a plan review, and I'll be trying really hard to pay attention to it. But within minutes, my mind is just off on three other job problems. I can't stay on track, and because of that, I end up missing things I know I absolutely should have caught. It's becoming a real issue for me.
Are you having trouble focusing or staying on track outside of work as well?

Yeah, it is. It's... it's really affecting things at home, too. My wife is just worn down from constantly having to remind me about things I said I would handle. I'll promise to take care of something and then it just completely falls off my radar. 

And honestly, it's hitting a breaking point at the job site as well. The missed follow-ups and just... poorly organized site coordination... it actually got bad enough recently that my employer brought up a formal concern about my performance. So, yeah, it's definitely causing real problems across the board.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

I guess I haven't really noticed that. I mean, I'm on my feet a lot on the job site, moving around, so... I don't know if I feel restless, exactly. Maybe? But it's not something that stands out to me.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

No, I wouldn't say so. I mean... in construction, you kind of have to plan things out, so I'm used to trying to think ahead. My problem isn't really doing things on a whim without thinking, it's more just... sticking to the plan once we start because my focus drifts away. So, no, I don't really act on impulse like that.
Have you experienced significant difficulties with organization and time management for a long time, even as a child?

Yeah, it's been an issue for as long as I can remember. Even way back in elementary school, my teachers were always telling my parents about it. They'd say I couldn't stay in my seat, or I was talking out of turn. I was always losing my homework, too. And when it came to assignments, I'd just rush right through the directions before I even really understood what I was supposed to be doing. So, yeah, this isn't anything new.
As a child, were you often described as fidgety or having excess energy?

I don't really remember anyone using those exact words. I mean, like I just said, they definitely told my parents I wouldn't stay in my seat. But I don't recall teachers or anyone specifically saying I was fidgety or had too much energy. I just remember getting in trouble for not staying put. So... I'm not really sure if they described it quite like that.
Are your focus problems and organizational issues causing problems in your relationships with friends or family beyond what your wife has mentioned?

Well, honestly, it's mostly with my wife at home and then my job. My friends haven't really said anything, but my wife is just... she's really worn down from constantly having to remind me about things I already promised I'd handle around the house. And at work, it's actually gotten pretty bad. I've missed a lot of follow-ups, and my site coordination has been so disorganized lately that my employer actually brought me in for a formal meeting to express their concern. So, yeah, it's definitely causing real problems, just mostly at work and with my marriage.
Do you have trouble managing your emotions, such as frequently feeling angry, anxious, or irritable?

Not really, no. I mean, sure, I get a little stressed when things go wrong on the job site, or if my wife is upset with me, but... I don't have a quick temper or anything like that. I don't walk around feeling anxious or angry. It's pretty much just the memory and the organizing stuff that I really struggle with.
Did you have more problems with behavior, such as talking back or refusing to follow rules, when you were a child?

No, not really. I mean, I wasn't a defiant kid or anything. I didn't talk back to my parents or teachers, and I didn't outright refuse to follow the rules. Like I said earlier, my main issue was just getting out of my seat when I was supposed to be sitting still. But as far as having an attitude or, you know, intentionally breaking rules... no, I don't remember having those kinds of problems.
Have you ever been told that you have trouble with impulsivity or hyperactivity, or have you ever felt like you have a lot of excess energy?

Not really, no. Nobody has ever come out and used the words hyperactive or impulsive to describe me. And as for excess energy... I don't know, I don't really feel like I have a ton of extra energy. I mean, I'm on my feet a lot at the job site, so I stay busy, but I wouldn't say I'm bouncing off the walls or anything like that. 

So, yeah, I'm not really sure about that one. Like I said, it's mostly just the focus and the organizing stuff that people actually point out to me.
Were you more active or restless than your peers when you were a child?

Yeah, I suppose I was. Like I brought up a minute ago about the seat thing... back in elementary school, my teachers were actually already telling my parents that I just couldn't stay in my seat. 

They also told them I talked out of turn a lot. Plus, I was always losing my homework, and, you know, just rushing through directions before I really even understood what I was supposed to be doing. So compared to the other kids in class, yeah, I guess I was definitely more restless.
Have you had problems with focus and organization in other areas of your life beyond work and home?

Not that I can think of, no. I mean... between managing the job site and dealing with stuff at the house, that pretty much takes up my whole life anyway. I don't really have a lot of other big commitments or hobbies where I'd even notice it. So, no, I'd say it's really just work and home where those things cause me trouble.
Do you often feel like you're fidgeting or have an inability to stay still when you're sitting for a long time?

No, I don't really think so. I mean, I don't sit for long stretches very often anyway since I'm mostly walking around the site all day. But even when I do sit down, like at the house in the evening, I don't feel like I have to keep moving or anything. I can just sit there. So no, I haven't noticed any fidgeting.
Have you experienced significant difficulties with focus and organization consistently across most areas of your life since childhood?

I don't really think so. I mean, like I was just saying, it's pretty much just work and home for me right now. And back when I was a kid, it was mostly just school where it was a big issue. 

I wouldn't say it's been a problem in every single area of my life... just the main ones where I actually have responsibilities or have to keep track of things, I guess. Outside of that, I haven't really noticed it being an issue everywhere else.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus and organization in multiple areas of your life for most of your life?

I mean, like I said, it's really just been work and home as an adult, and school when I was younger. I don't think it's been a problem in *every* part of my life. Just the parts where I have to actually get things done or keep things straight. If I don't have any major responsibilities in a certain area, I don't really notice any issues. So, no, not everywhere.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus and organization in social situations?

Not really. I mean... when I'm hanging out with friends or whatever, there's not exactly anything to organize. We usually just grab a beer or watch a game. And I don't really have trouble paying attention when we're just shooting the breeze. So no, I haven't noticed any problems like that when I'm just being social.
Do you think your difficulties with focus and organization are more related to paying attention to details or more about being disorganized and forgetful?

Honestly, I'm not really sure. I haven't ever really tried to separate them out like that. It feels like... well, it all just kind of runs together into one big problem for me. I guess I do both, but I couldn't tell you if one is actually worse than the other.
Have you had problems with focus and organization in multiple different settings throughout your life?

I think we just covered that, didn't we? Like I said, it's mostly been an issue at work, at home, and back when I was in school. I wouldn't say it's happening in every single setting, just the ones where I have actual responsibilities and things to manage.
Do you often feel the need to be active and have trouble engaging in activities quietly?

No, not really. I mean... my job keeps me pretty active anyway, being out on a job site all day. But when I'm off the clock, I don't have any issue just sitting in my chair and watching TV or whatever. I don't feel like I always have to be moving around or doing something.
Did your problems with focus and organization start when you were a child?

Yeah, they definitely did. I mean, going way back to elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents about it. They said I couldn't stay in my seat and that I talked out of turn a lot. I was always losing my homework, too. And... well, I guess I always rushed through directions before I really understood what I was supposed to be doing. So, yeah, it's been an issue since I was a kid.
